content.value_statement: Long-running AI projects lose context across sessions and agent handoffs. This skill guides semantic retrieval, ranking, and validation for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code continuity.
actual_capabilities: Defines required inputs for context source, project identifier, restoration mode, token budget, and relevance threshold.
Explains semantic vector search patterns for retrieving relevant project memory.
Guides relevance ranking with semantic similarity, temporal relevance, and historical impact signals.
Shows token-aware context rehydration patterns for selective restoration.
Covers session state reconstruction, context merging, validation checks, and integrity safeguards.
Provides reference workflows for project resumption and cross-project knowledge transfer.
limitations: It is guidance documentation, not a working context restoration service.
Referenced storage systems, vector databases, and helper functions must be supplied by the user environment.
The linked implementation playbook is not included in the scanned file structure.
Outputs still require project-specific validation, testing, and permission checks.

use_cases.title: Resume Complex AI Projects
use_cases.description: Restore the most relevant decisions, architecture notes, and recent work before continuing a long-running project.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Handoffs
use_cases.description: Create a structured context package so another assistant or team member can continue work with less discovery time.

use_cases.title: Design Memory Retrieval Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan semantic search, ranking, merge, and validation patterns for agent memory systems.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Context Restore
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a paused project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the context restoration skill to plan how to resume my project. Ask for the context source, project identifier, restoration mode, token budget, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Rank Available Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the relevance ranking guidance to my available context items. Prioritize them by semantic relevance, recency, decision impact, and token cost.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Handoff Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Transfer work to another agent or teammate
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the session reconstruction workflow to create a handoff summary. Include current state, key decisions, open issues, risks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Restoration Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a context restoration pipeline using semantic retrieval, incremental loading, conflict resolution, provenance tracking, and integrity checks for a multi-agent system.

output_examples.input: Resume a paused web platform project with limited token budget.
output_examples.output: A prioritized restoration plan that loads project overview, recent agent work, known issues, and key architecture decisions first.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff after several AI agents contributed to the same repository.
output_examples.output: A concise handoff summary covering current state, decision trail, unresolved conflicts, validation checks, and recommended next steps.

output_examples.input: Compare two versions of project context before continuing work.
output_examples.output: A merge checklist that identifies overlapping facts, conflicting decisions, stale notes, and context items that need source validation.

best_practices: Define the context source, project identifier, restoration mode, and token budget before retrieval begins.
Rank context with both semantic relevance and practical project impact.
Validate restored context against the current codebase and documented decisions before acting on it.
anti_patterns: Restoring every stored note without relevance filtering or token budgeting.
Treating stale context as authoritative without checking the current project state.
Merging context from different projects without provenance or conflict review.

faq.question: Does this skill restore context automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and workflow patterns. Users must connect their own storage, retrieval, and validation systems.

faq.question: Which restoration modes does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes full restoration, incremental updates, and diff-based comparison with merge review.

faq.question: Can it work with vector databases?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes semantic vector search and ranking concepts for vector-backed context retrieval.

faq.question: How does it manage token limits?
faq.answer: It recommends prioritizing context components and loading only items that fit within the chosen token budget.

faq.question: Is it specific to one AI assistant?
faq.answer: No. It is framed for multi-agent AI workflows and supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code marketplace metadata.

faq.question: What should users verify after restoration?
faq.answer: Users should verify source freshness, decision traceability, semantic consistency, and compatibility with the current project state.
